description: Did this settled payment deliver the expected asset and amount to the expected account? When to use: After a payment has been submitted: to confirm from the ledger that it delivered the asset and amount you expected to the account you expected, including the partial-payment case. Prefer another tool: Before sending a payment (use `/v1/xrpl/payment-readiness`), or to list an account's recent payments (use `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/transactions`). Example: xrpl_payment_verify {"hash":"002C12C53476173ABC1001505C40A24CCC90F642480C924C1B748E339FA1B069","destination":"rfaecmugiPaAkFpBT9Bmq8f3n42oXe6m1C","asset":"XRP","amount":"0.00001"}

amount.description: Positive decimal amount of asset the payment had to deliver (at most 6 decimals for XRP, whole base units for an MPT)

asset.description: Asset the payment had to deliver. `XRP`, or `CODE.issuer`: `CODE` is a 3-character standard code or 40 hexadecimal digits, and `issuer` is a classic XRPL address. Standard codes are case-sensitive: `usd` and `USD` are different tokens, so send the exact code. A standard code uses letters, digits or `?!@#$%^&*<>(){}[]|` and is never `XRP`; percent-encode the symbols in a URL (for example `%3F` for `?`). A 40-hex code is read in any case, and the 40-hex form of a standard code means that code. Or a 48-hex MPT issuance id (hex letters in either case), with `amount` in whole base units.

destination.description: Account the payment had to reach: valid classic XRPL address (r..., checksum verified)

destination_tag.description: Destination tag the payment had to carry: an integer from 0 to 4294967295; omit to skip the tag check

hash.description: Transaction hash of the payment to verify: 64 hexadecimal characters

last_ledger_sequence.description: The LastLedgerSequence the payer signed: an integer from 1 to 4294967295; pass it for a definitive answer when the transaction is absent

source.description: Account the payment had to come from; omit to skip the sender check

name: xrpl_payment_verify

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time, not of the ledger close time

as_of.description: When we read the data from the ledger (our read time), not the ledger close time

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

ledger_index.description: Ledger the data comes from; ledger_state says whether it is validated or open; null when no read behind the answer names a ledger, never 0

ledger_state.description: State of the ledger ledger_index names: open for the fee read, which reads the open ledger, else validated; a composite answer is open only when every read is

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

value.description: Decimal string in units of `asset`, exact; null for an MPT, since the verify reads no MPT issuance and so no `AssetScale` (its base units are in `value_atomic`)

value_atomic.description: MPT only: the exact amount in whole base units; absent for XRP and issued currencies

delivered.description: What the transaction actually delivered (`delivered_amount`, never `Amount`); null when there is no transaction or its delivered amount is unavailable

destination_tag.description: Destination tag queried (echo of `destination_tag`); null when the request sent none

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

value.description: Decimal string in units of `asset`, exact; null for an MPT, since the verify reads no MPT issuance and so no `AssetScale` (its base units are in `value_atomic`)

value_atomic.description: MPT only: the exact amount in whole base units; absent for XRP and issued currencies

excess.description: Delivered minus expected when `paid`, the same amount object as `expected` and `delivered`; null otherwise

expected.description: The asset and amount the request asked to confirm

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

value.description: Decimal string in units of `asset`, exact; null for an MPT, since the verify reads no MPT issuance and so no `AssetScale` (its base units are in `value_atomic`)

value_atomic.description: MPT only: the exact amount in whole base units; absent for XRP and issued currencies

failure_code.description: The `TransactionResult` of a validated transaction that did not succeed (not `tesSUCCESS`), such as `tecPATH_DRY`, whatever the verdict; a result that does not match ^[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,40}$ is reported as `unknown_error`. Null when there is no transaction, the transaction is not validated yet (`not_final`) or it succeeded

hash.description: Transaction hash queried (echo of `hash`, canonicalized to upper case)

invoice_id.description: The transaction's `InvoiceID`, 64-hex as the ledger holds it; null when absent or when there is no transaction

last_ledger_sequence.description: Last ledger sequence queried (echo of `last_ledger_sequence`); null when the request sent none

ledger_index.description: Validated ledger holding the transaction; null when there is no transaction or the node's answer for it names no ledger, never 0

partial_payment.description: True when the payment carried `tfPartialPayment`, so less than `Amount` could be delivered; null when there is no transaction

sender.description: The sending account (`Account`) of the transaction; null when there is no transaction or it carries no `Account`

settled_at.description: When the payment settled: the close time of that ledger; null when there is no transaction or its close time is unavailable

source.description: Source account queried (echo of `source`); null when the request sent none

transaction_destination_tag.description: The transaction's `DestinationTag`; null when absent or when there is no transaction

flag.description: Which side is assumed at par: the USD peg (`assumed_parity`) or the EUR peg

fx_rate_date.description: Date of the ECB reference rate used, the latest on or before the payment's date

note.description: That the value is an informative reference, not a tax figure

usd_per_eur.description: The ECB reference rate used, in USD per EUR, as stored; `value_eur` = `value_usd` / `usd_per_eur`

value_eur.description: Delivered value in EUR, a decimal string rounded half-up to 18 decimal places

value_usd.description: Delivered value in USD, a decimal string rounded half-up to 18 decimal places

verdict.description: The first verdict that matches, in the documented order
